title: Parsed Runner Event
description: Normalized record returned by web/lib/runner-v2/events.ts after reading a physical key-value .event file. Event names are intentionally open because chains define their own handoff vocabulary.

event.description: System event name or chain-defined handoff event.

source.description: Agent/session/system source. Diagnostic events may fall back to the physical agent field.

runId.description: Normalized from run_id or runId. Empty is retained for legacy/global events.

timestamp.description: Timestamp as persisted. Legacy records may leave it empty.

fields.description: All first-occurrence physical key-value fields, normalized to lowercase keys.

canonicalSystemEventType.description: Known platform lifecycle vocabulary. This is documentation, not a closed event-name gate.
